The height of a step in a Motzkin path is the y coordinate of the ending point. Given two sequences b = (b0 , b1 , . . .) and λ = (λ0 , λ1 , . . .), the weight of a Motzkin path with respect to (b, λ) is the product of bi and λi for each horizontal step and down step of height i respectively, see Figure 1.
